name: com.unanite.virtualgeometry
description: Virtualized geometry for Unity 6 (Nanite-style cluster DAG, GPU-driven culling, visibility buffer, page streaming). Primary target HDRP 17, secondary URP 17. D3D12 first, Vulkan second.

samples.description: HDRP. Builds a dense scanned quarry from your Megascans downloads (Tools > UNanite > Samples > Quarry Scene imports them) or from procedural rocks, as virtual geometry; flythrough, stats overlay, V switches to Unity's renderers (Mesh LOD, LODGroups, terrain) for comparisons.
